text: • Use a 25 cm measuring cylinder to pour 20 cm of distilled water into the polystyrene cup.
• Use a thermometer to measure the initial temperature of the distilled water.
• Add 1.0 g of sodium thiosulfate powder to the distilled water in the polystyrene cup and
immediately start a stop-watch. Stir the mixture with the thermometer.
• Measure the temperature of the solution at 1 minute.
• Rinse out the polystyrene cup with distilled water.
• Repeat Experiment 1 using 2.0 g of sodium thiosulfate powder instead of 1.0 g.
• Repeat Experiment 1 using 3.0 g of sodium thiosulfate powder instead of 1.0 g.
• Repeat Experiment 1 using 4.0 g of sodium thiosulfate powder instead of 1.0 g.
• Repeat Experiment 1 using 5.0 g of sodium thiosulfate powder instead of 1.0 g.
